planned_session.purpose: Starts + race-pace 5x3 -- last hard session before the peak weekend
planned_session.structure:
Warm-up: 15min ramp 131-181W, 3min @ 211W, 3min easy, 2 x (5s burst / 55s easy).
Starts: 5 x (30s race start, all-out from a standstill / 4min easy 145W). Lap before each; stop on a rep clearly weaker than your best.
Race pace: 5 x (3min @ 278-286W with a technical section (corner sequence + barrier or run-up, one remount) / 3min easy). Stop if the 5th is >5% below the 1st; 4 reps if flat.
Endurance add-on: 45min easy Z2 spin (145-170W), continuous.
Cool-down: 10min easy.
Skip it if you have a cold or slept badly two nights running.
